subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

I have been calling him **__from__** many days.
solution:
The correct answer is "for."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the use of the preposition** "from"** with the expression **"many days."**
 
• The correct preposition to indicate the duration of time in this context is **"for"** instead of **"from."**
 
• Using **"from"** suggests a starting point in time, which is not appropriate here because the focus is on the duration of time over which the action has been occurring.
 
• The reason to use **"For"** instead of **"From"** is to indicate the duration of time during which the action of calling has been ongoing.
 
• In this sentence, **"for"** is a preposition that introduces the duration of time, which is **"many days."**
 
• It specifies that the action of calling has been occurring continuously over the period of **"many days."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

**Correct sentence**:* I have been calling him **for**__ many days.*
